result:
The background simulation finished and matches my earlier answer. On the simulated GB300 NVL72, a 64 MiB all-reduce with one NVLink at half rate gave:

| Algorithm | Healthy | Faulted | Slowdown |
|---|---|---|---|
| NVLS | 174.4 µs | 261.6 µs | 1.4998× |
| Ring | 566.6 µs | 567.1 µs | 1.0009× |

NVLS stripes the data across all 18 links, so the half-rate link sets the finish time. Its bandwidth term would double, but fixed latency and protocol costs dilute that to about 1.5×. A ring spreads each hop over all of a GPU's links, so the one slow link has almost no effect.

```json
{"nvls_slowdown": 1.4998, "ring_slowdown": 1.0009}
```
